title: AI narrative drafting
subtitle: Draft framework-aligned narrative from your approved disclosure data. Figures come from approved values only; missing inputs are flagged, never invented.

provider.tooltip: The AI provider is set per organisation in Settings → Market & compliance.

brief.title: Drafting brief
brief.body: Choose what to draft. The model only sees approved values for the current reporting year.

sections.esrsE3: ESRS E3 — Water and marine resources
sections.esrsE5: ESRS E5 — Resource use and circular economy

assurances.anchored: Every figure comes from an approved value
assurances.gaps: Missing inputs are listed as gaps, not estimated
assurances.labelled: Output is labelled as AI-generated, including when copied

progress.check: Checking each figure against its source value

label.review: AI-generated draft. A person must review it before it is published.

toast.copied: Draft copied with its AI-generated label
toast.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy to the clipboard. Select the text and copy it manually.
toast.insertBody: Paste it into the section in the disclosure editor. The AI-generated label is included.

errors.generateFailed: The draft could not be generated.
errors.draftFailedBody: Nothing was saved. Try again; if it keeps failing, the AI provider may be unavailable.

disabled.meanwhile: Write the narrative in the disclosure editor. Approved values are still available there.

organisation.title: AI drafting is switched off for your organisation
organisation.body: An administrator has disabled AI features for this workspace, so no draft can be generated and no data is sent to an AI provider.

deployment.title: No AI provider is configured for this deployment
deployment.body: This Nexus environment has no AI provider credentials, so drafting is unavailable for every organisation on it.
deployment.who: Your platform administrator (the team that operates this Nexus deployment)
deployment.where: Deployment environment: AI provider API key

empty.title: Ready to draft
empty.body: Choose a framework and section, then select Draft with AI. The draft appears here, labelled as AI-generated, for you to review.

emptyDraft: The model returned an empty draft. Try again or choose another section.
